title: Ilédì Oǹtótóo, Second Palace

terrainReference.basis: Native terrain at the approximate center of the published aerial scan area.

note: The draft centers on the published scan coverage and faces approximately south, 173.7° true, following the best exterior panorama fit. The panorama pin differs from the archive center by about 167 m, and the interior panorama supports a different direction. The model envelope clears the mapped road and river at this trial position. The actual footprint, ground datum and bearing remain unresolved.
